subject: RE: FW: AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL - TLV / 104 CRATES 302 KGS
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you quote the fastest air freight option for some electronic control units going to SCL (Santiago, CL)? The shipment will be ready for pickup at our site in 53521 (Bonn), Germany, on 2026-11-25. Could you arrange the truck from our site to the airport as well?

Lot 1: 1 carton, together 465 kg gross (404 kg net), together 3.87 cbm
Lot 2: 3 pallets, each 160 kg gross (142 kg net), each 100 x 60 x 46 cm
Lot 3: 3 drums, each 59 kg gross (55 kg net), each 110 x 110 x 128 cm

Please keep the lots together as a single consignment under one air waybill. A single all-in price in EUR covering the whole shipment, including pickup, would be great. Could you also let me know the earliest arrival you can offer?

Thanks for taking a look!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
